name: io.github.omercebeci/hesapnokta-science
title: HesapNokta Science
description: Verified physics and chemistry calculators for AI agents: search in plain English, run with units.

tools.name: search_calculators
tools.description: Search physics and chemistry calculators in English. Include the unknown quantity and the quantities you know. Returns up to five matches; the first includes its input schema, and notFor says when a neighbour fits better. Units in other systems (lbf, psi, ft, °F) are converted, so a matching formula is usable.

tools.name: get_calculator_schema
tools.description: Get input fields, accepted units, and an example when available.

id.description: Stable calculator ID returned by search.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Run a calculator by ID using its input schema. For science answers, copy calculatorId as the calculator ID and read the value and unit from results[target].

id.description: Stable calculator ID returned by search.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List published categories and calculator counts.
